title: Annotation API NER-NEL response
description: Response body of POST /api/ner-nel/: NER then NEL on the detected mentions. Same keys as the /api/nel/ response, but `nes` is always a list.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

sys_id.description: Identifier of the system (model) that served the request.

NEL seconds.description: NEL processing time in seconds. Frozen wire name containing a space.

NER seconds.description: NER time in seconds: the `NER seconds` of the request (0 when absent), or the NER step of /api/ner-nel/. Frozen wire name containing a space.

nes.description: Linked mentions found in the text.
